title: A synthetic walk from A to T
summary: Nothing here is history. This narrative exists so the reading mode can be opened, stepped through and left without any real record being involved.

steps.text: The walk opens on an event rather than on a link, so the first step has a selection and no chain behind it.
The second step is an edge, which selects its own far end and starts the chain the map draws in madder.
A third step joined to the second: the chain is two links long here, because the far end of one is the near end of the next.
This step is deliberately not joined to the one before it, so the chain breaks and starts again from a single link.
